plan-review-container.eval.yaml cases carry only input (parent plan) but no children list, unlike the working precedent plan-review-decomp-shape.eval.yaml which includes both

_run_criterion_case and the real provider-parity gate both use pass1_container over a (parent, children, sibling_roster) decomposition, so a children-carrying fixture is the correct runnable shape
